'''Virtual Block 9''' is a Players Committee '''legacy''' virtual expansion from the late pre-reset period. These cards are no longer valid for competitive play; use the Decipher sets and the current virtual sets (2014 Reset onward).

The official sheets are titled Virtual Block 9: Republic At War,<ref name="vb91pdf">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock9_1.pdf ''Virtual Block 9: Republic At War''] (PDF), res.starwarsccg.org. Cover: "Official text as of January 10, 2014". Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261020174637/https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock9_1.pdf Internet Archive]</ref> and Virtual Block 9: Twilight Of The Republic.<ref name="vb92pdf">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock9_2.pdf ''Virtual Block 9: Twilight Of The Republic''] (PDF), res.starwarsccg.org. Cover: "Official text as of July 14, 2014". Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261023013408/https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock9_2.pdf Internet Archive]</ref> The Players Committee issued the cards as printed slips: print the sheet, cut out the area beneath the card title, and sleeve the cutout with the original card.

Virtual Set 9.1 ''Republic at War'' was released '''10 January 2014''' and legal immediately (primary PC post).<ref name="vb91">https://web.archive.org/web/20140115143606/http://www.starwarsccg.org/wp/v-set-9-1-is-live/</ref> The hub Date gives the range '''2013–2014''' (Legacy Virtual Blocks era ending with the October 2014 V-Card reset).<ref name="vb9era">[https://www.starwarsccg.org/resources/virtual-slips/ Virtual Slips / Files], starwarsccg.org. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20240920164229/https://www.starwarsccg.org/resources/virtual-slips/ Internet Archive].</ref> Do not confuse with modern Virtual Set 9 (2018).

The combined legacy list is also published as Virtual Master on the Players Committee cardlists.


Some of these cards were later reused in the current virtual sets (2014 Reset onward), usually with updated frames and set icons.

== Releases ==

Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261020174637/https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock9_1.pdf Internet Archive].</ref>

Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261023013408/https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock9_2.pdf Internet Archive].</ref>

| 05 || [[File:VB9-05-Arena_Execution.png|320px|link=Arena Execution]] || [[File:VB9-D-arenaexecution-pre.gif|200px|link=Arena Execution]] || style="white-space:nowrap" | [[Arena Execution]] || style="white-space:nowrap" | [[Mission|Mission]] || Deploy on [[War Has Begun]]. [Virtual Block 2] [[Special Delivery (V)|Special Delivery]] is canceled. May deploy [[Arena Pillars]] from Reserve Deck; reshuffle. [[Geonosis: Petranaki Arena (Dark)|Petranaki Arena]] is a prison. If there are no captives at Petranaki Arena and opponent about to lose a non-droid character, may imprison it there. If opponent controls Petranaki Arena during their control phase, they may release any number of captives there. If an opponent's imprisoned character was just 'executed,' stack it here face down (Mission complete).<br />'''Reward:''' Attrition against opponent is +1.<br />'''Turn the Tide:''' If opponent controls Petranaki Arena during their control phase, place this Mission in Used Pile.
|-
| 05 || [[File:VB9-05-Defense_Of_Muunilinst.png|320px|link=Defense Of Muunilinst]] || [[File:VB9-D-defenseofmuunilinst-pre.gif|200px|link=Defense Of Muunilinst]] || style="white-space:nowrap" | [[Defense Of Muunilinst]] || style="white-space:nowrap" | [[Mission|Mission]] || Deploy on [[War Has Begun]]. Unless a card stacked here, if you control three [[Muunilinst]] locations (and opponent controls no Muunilinst locations), opponent loses 1 Force (cannot be reduced) and stacks lost card here face down (Mission complete).<br />'''Reward:''' Your Force drains at Muunilinst locations are +1 and, once per turn, may raise your converted Muunilinst site to the top.<br />'''Turn the Tide:''' If opponent controls two Muunilinst locations, place this Mission in Used Pile.
|-
| 05 || [[File:VB9-05-Rally_To_Our_Cause.png|320px|link=Rally To Our Cause]] || [[File:VB9-D-rallytoourcause-pre.gif|200px|link=Rally To Our Cause]] || style="white-space:nowrap" | [[Rally To Our Cause]] || style="white-space:nowrap" | [[Mission|Mission]] || Deploy on [[War Has Begun]]. During your control phase, for each system where you occupy a related site, may draw one destiny; if destiny + X + Y > 7, stack top card of Lost Pile under that system (limit one per system); it is 'aligned' (Mission complete).<br />X = number of 'aligned' systems on table.<br />Y = number of unique (•) [Separatist] characters on table.<br />'''Reward:''' Your battle destiny draws are +X (limit +2).<br />'''Turn the Tide:''' If opponent just initiated a Force drain at an 'aligned' system, place stacked cards there in Used Pile (system no longer 'aligned'). If there are no 'aligned' systems on table, place this Mission in Used Pile.
|}
